environment.description: IoT message handler deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e9b1d4e5f6) in us-east-1, exposed directly via public ALB (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/iot-msg-handler/abc123). Security group sg-0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8 allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. ALB forwards to target group on port 8080. Device authentication relies solely on the validate_device_token() check in application code (currently not enforced on /api/v1/devices/lookup endpoint). SQLite database at /var/iot/devices.db contains device telemetry and registry data.

config.network: Public ALB, no WAF, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
config.auth: No authentication enforced on lookup endpoint
